name: overdueOffboardingCount
definition: How many people Vanta shows as overdue on their offboarding tasks (status OFFBOARDING_OVERDUE).
population: every person in Vanta's people list; the count is of those overdue on offboarding
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete paged read of Vanta's people list, every entry readable with a known status and at least one person read. 0 is the secure state; an unreadable or partial read is Not evaluated, never 0.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation, a Vanta third-party-proof (level 3) transform. Synthetic-fixture tests only; no real Vanta body with values was replayed, so V0.

notes: Reported with peopleRead so a real 0 is told apart from a parse that found nothing.
